sources.note: Each home's staffing during the management period.

caveats: Management relationships are the organizations a nursing home reported to CMS with operational or managerial control (or as a contracted managing employee). CMS publishes what facilities report, and reports can lag actual changes.
Operational or managerial control is not the same as ownership or legal responsibility. A home's own parent or sponsoring organization can hold this role, as can an outside management company.

Periods are observed in monthly CMS releases from January 2020 to the latest release. A relationship already in place in January 2020 starts at the association date CMS reports. An ended relationship ended between the last release that listed it and the next release.
Facility conditions during a management period reflect many factors and are not a measure of the management company's performance.
Listing is not an allegation of wrongdoing.
Staffing context comes from CMS Payroll-Based Journal data, which starts in Q4 2017.
corrections_notice: Records come from public state and federal sources. To report an error, email hello@danbeem.xyz.
